title: In segment, cheap, but under an open FDA consent decree

input.facts: Immunoassay analyzers and point-of-care tests; reagents are 66% of sales. The company operates under an FDA consent decree since last year after repeated manufacturing quality findings; the decree remains open, shipments of two product lines are suspended and the remediation timeline is not disclosed. The share price is down 48%. Leverage 2.6x. No large holder.

why: A major unresolved regulatory issue is a kill criterion. Reject.
